name: Creator, Audio & Media Products

designIntent.primaryGoal: Make discovery, playback and library management immediate and understandable.
designIntent.visualThesis: Media content supplies the emotional identity; controls remain precise and persistent.

visualDirection.density: medium; dense libraries need compact, scannable rows
visualDirection.surfaces: content artwork may dominate; player and navigation remain stable
visualDirection.colorIntent: artwork-led accent can be used carefully, but control labels and playback states need reliable contrast
visualDirection.typography: metadata hierarchy separates title, creator, album/show and duration
visualDirection.motion: playback transitions and progress feedback; avoid motion that hides controls

layout.pattern: navigation + discovery/library surface + persistent player or media controls
layout.spacing: balanced cards for discovery and compact rows for large libraries
layout.responsive: player controls adapt without hiding primary actions or current item

accessibility.keyboard: media controls, queue and navigation must be keyboard accessible
accessibility.focus: playback state is announced and visibly represented
accessibility.reducedMotion: animated artwork is optional and can be disabled

antiPatterns: artwork color used as the only status cue
player controls that shift layout constantly
notes: Do not assume a provider has playback rights or capabilities that its API does not document.
